class.description: A custom costmap layer that paints probabilistic predictions of human positions onto the navigation costmap. The layer subscribes to `PredictedPositionArray` messages published by a dummy prediction node and uses anisotropic Gaussian kernels to mark the area around each predicted mean. Each prediction includes a confidence level and standard deviations in x and y; the plugin scales cost values according to the confidence and spreads them according to the sigmas. This simulates the confidence sets produced by a probabilistic trajectory prediction network【567447048113654†L319-L331】 and allows path planners to avoid predicted pedestrian positions.
